Table.Name: Command
Table.Command:
SELECT T10.Name as 'GrupoVehic', T4.ItmsGrpNam as 'Grupo', avg(T8.U_OrdenGrupo) as 'OrdenGrupo', T8.Code as 'CodGrupoLista', T8.Name as 'NombreGrupoLista', T8.U_EncGrupo, avg(T9.U_OrdenSubGrupo) as 'OrdenSubGrupo', T9.Code as 'CodSubGrupoLista', T9.Name as 'NombreSubgrupoLista', T9.U_EncSubGrupo, avg(T0.[U_NS_OrdenEnLista]) as [OrdenEnLista], T0.[ItemCode], T0.[SWW] as 'PLU', T11.Name as 'Marca', T0.[ItemName], T0.[U_NS_DescAdic], T0.[FrgnName], T2.[Currency], avg(T2.[Price]) as 'Precio', sum(T1.[OnHand]) as 'Stock', sum(T1.[OnOrder]) as 'OrdenCompra',
CASE WHEN sum(T1.[OnHand]) >0 THEN 'X' ELSE '_' END AS 'Hand',
CASE WHEN sum(T1.[OnOrder]) >0 THEN 'X' ELSE '_' END AS 'Ord',
T2.[Ovrwritten], T3.[FirmName] as 'Fabrica', T0.QryGroup14, T0.QryGroup18, T0.QryGroup19, T0.QryGroup11, 'Z-' + right(left(convert(nvarchar(7),T0.LastPurDat,20),4),2) AS 'UltCompra' FROM OITM T0 INNER JOIN OITW T1 ON T0.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode INNER JOIN ITM1 T2 ON T0.ItemCode = T2.ItemCode INNER JOIN OMRC T3 ON T0.FirmCode = T3.FirmCode INNER JOIN OITB T4 ON T0.ItmsGrpCod = T4.ItmsGrpCod INNER JOIN OWHS T5 ON T1.WhsCode = T5.WhsCode INNER JOIN OPLN T6 ON T2.PriceList = T6.ListNum INNER JOIN OARG T7 ON T0.CstGrpCode = T7.CstGrpCode LEFT JOIN [@NS_GRUPOLISTA] T8 ON T0.U_NS_GrupoLista = T8.Code LEFT JOIN [@NS_SUBGRUPOLISTA] T9 ON T0.U_NS_SubgrupoLista = T9.Code LEFT JOIN [@NS_GRUPO_VEHICULO] T10 ON T0.U_NS_GrupoVehic = T10.Code LEFT JOIN [@NS_MARCA_PARTE] T11 ON T0.U_NS_MarcaParte = T11.Code WHERE T6.[ListName] like 'A01%' --T0.U_NS_SaleEnLista ='Y' and and (T5.[WhsName] like '102%' or T5.[WhsName] LIKE '202%') -- or T5.[WhsName] LIKE '151%' or T5.[WhsName] LIKE '251%' -- and (T4.ItmsGrpNam like '1%' or T4.ItmsGrpNam like '201%' or T4.ItmsGrpNam like '202%') group by T10.Name, T4.ItmsGrpNam, T8.U_OrdenGrupo, T9.U_Ordensubgrupo, T8.Code, T8.Name, T8.U_EncGrupo, T9.Code, T9.Name, T9.U_EncSubGrupo, T0.[U_NS_OrdenEnLista], T0.[ItemCode], T0.[SWW], T11.Name, T0.[ItemName], T0.[U_NS_DescAdic], T0.[FrgnName], T2.[Currency], T2.[Ovrwritten], T3.[FirmName], T0.QryGroup1, T0.QryGroup14, T0.QryGroup18, T0.QryGroup19, T0.QryGroup11, T0.LastPurDat HAVING sum(T1.[OnHand]) >0 ORDER BY T10.Name, t8.U_EncGrupo, T9.U_ENCSubGrupo, T0.ItemName
